style: 冷色水晶矿洞，层叠不规则岩环与晶脉

rules.title: 矿洞
rules.scatter_rule: 保持岩环原图比例，85U一层；分叉尚未分离时使用公共岩腔与独立岩块。
rules.junction_rule: 按横截面路线距离分组，单owner；分离后再恢复岩环，不拉伸整个岩门。
rules.top_rule: 岩环只是截面；核查环间空区在正式照明中是否穿帮；自然暗部衔接可保留，明亮暴露区补同材质顶件。

ground.source: design_initial; measure runtime slope before acceptance

lighting.diagnostic: freeze exact camera and simulation; white ambient; fog/virtual lights disabled; bright background
lighting.acceptance: Diagnostic gaps are observations. Accept matched dark background/sky/fog joins when production lighting and supported light changes remain convincing; require local geometry for visibly lit gaps.

examples: narrow rock ring, asymmetric ring, broken decorative ring
left rock buttress, right buttress, freestanding rock
rubble, chips, grit, low stone shelf
small shard group, angled cluster, large vein
tileable rock ceiling skin and curved transition patch
kit.root_policy: Mark both ring supports and lower opening; rock overhang is not a support footprint. Crystal tips must not be used as floor anchors.
kit.assembly: Ring spacing 4.25m is the old visual cadence, not roof closure. Continuous rock ceiling behind rings owns inter-ring gaps. Separate roots/rubble fill only ground contact seams.
kit.light_fx: Cool reference tint and limited crystal emissive accents. Ceiling drips originate on verified rock surface and terminate at ground; one pooled emitter group.
kit.junction: Group corridor cross-sections by overlap; one common chamber while overlapping, split rings only after both supports clear all exits. Never stretch a complete ring across the junction.
kit.lighting_acceptance: Choose open/atmospheric/hybrid/geometric. Compare diagnostic with production lighting and actual permitted changes before deciding roof asset scope.
